summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the upload directory by name. Changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.description: The download handler joins the request's name parameter to UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path like /etc/passwd escapes the upload directory. Any caller can read any file the server process can read. That includes secrets, config and source code. Resolve the joined path with os.path.realpath and reject it unless it lies under the resolved UPLOAD_DIR. Alternatively use flask.send_from_directory, which enforces this check.

findings.title: Debug server exposed on all interfaces
findings.description: The change turns on debug mode and switches the bind address from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0. The interactive Werkzeug debugger is now reachable from the network. A network user who triggers an error can open the debugger console. That user can then run arbitrary code on the host. Keep host 127.0.0.1 and turn off debug by default. Read both values from environment configuration if they need to change.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no test
findings.description: The repository has no tests that exercise the new download handler. Nothing covers the not-found path or the containment of names. A regression in path handling or the 404 branch would reach users without anyone noticing. Add tests for a valid file, a missing file and a traversal attempt that the handler must reject.
